## Change

Describe the trigger, resulting behaviour and relevant issue.

## Validation

- [ ] Full local suite passed through the pre-commit hook
- [ ] Changeset added for firmware, companion, test or pipeline changes
- [ ] No credentials or private build artifacts included
- [ ] Device testing and any remaining hardware limitations described

## Risks

Note RAM/PSRAM, UI responsiveness, networking, time/location, OTA/partition and compatibility impacts where applicable.
